messages.subject: ERROR(s) during compilation on pi
parts:
Hi

I have C++ errors during compilation the following model:

parameters {
   simplex[3] pi;
}

model {
}

generated quantities {
   real mu;
   mu <- 2*pi();
}

It seems to have a collision between pi and pi().  Could you fix it?

-Bee
